title: Prove a census-free pair-reader floor for orthonormal partitions
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp actual-reader floor `m_A+m_B` for every finite pair-span realization over every coefficient field, conditionally for **any finite even orthonormal partition of binary labels**. Groups have positive even size and binary Gram I; planes are consecutive pairs and indicators are alternating halves. Readers may cancel outside the target. Axes, repetitions, zero queries and arbitrarily many projective directions are included. Disjoint pair replacements preserve whole-K tariff `2n` for `n` ports.

```diff
 literal P112 pair-reader bounds
- at most three directions, dense-only proof, or a fixed-geometry rank census
+ census-free characteristic-two transfer for every even orthonormal partition
```

Map projective classes injectively into `F2(t)`, fixing axes. Choose new readers inside their old class-union supports. Binary rectangular rank does not increase; the expanded identity has rank `2n` over the extension. This uses actual readers throughout and does not assume a homomorphism from the original field.

Concurrent [PR3459](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3459), CubeJerry at `d1703ebc3f5c0e0b47fa37066a2288367402973a`, reports the same literal PR3370 conclusion using submodular layers and a finite census. It has concurrent credit for that literal result. This PR contributes a different proof and the general-partition quantifiers. Its proof/body were inspected; its implementation was not replayed or imported. [PR3429](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3429)'s binary-map obstruction and [PR3447](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3447)'s stronger dense-only bound are respected.

Only `research/p112-extension-field-reader-floor/` changes. The package contains the proof, source pins, unchanged attributed PR3370 fixture, two standalone implementations, receipt, controls, replay manifest and open next questions. No new kappa, native supplier or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the literal mixed-list question had the concurrent source-bound census above. **After:** the written extension-field proof needs no geometry census and applies to every partition satisfying its stated hypotheses.
- Primary replay checks all 496 literal pairs through 992 exact rational-to-GF64 fixtures, 8,432 grouped tariff comparisons, 444,416 operator coordinates and every expanded-I224 entry. Proportional repetitions, zero queries and outside-reader cancellation are included.
- A separate coordinate/GF16 implementation rejects all 256 binary maps of the old four-direction example and solves all twelve requests over an extension. It checks 133,363 prime-field tuples, 6,074 support transfers and 1,984 rectangular rank comparisons. Three non-P112 fixtures add 416 expanded entries; odd and nonorthonormal groups are rejected.
- Seven actual optimized CLI corruptions fail at their intended gates. Registered CPython 3.12.15, optimized CPython 3.15, Ruff diagnostics/formatting, exact committed bytes/source history and all three scripts normal/optimized on the unchanged Git-free committed export pass.

Replay with an existing private external `TMPDIR`:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-extension-field-reader-floor
```

Base and submission-refresh canonical main are `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Publication commit is `194518404309c76b542e57efa52c0ed6e57cc48c`. No pending predecessor code or Git-history object is needed. Tekalign/PR3370 supplies the retained fixture; Philippe Van Velzen/PR3345 supplies the expanded-identity argument. Immediate predecessor, concurrent and full P112/E8/compiler/supplier credit is retained in the package.

The all-partition quantifier is proved in the written argument; finite fixtures corroborate it. Human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. External query dimensions, larger jointly recoded blocks, shared native operations, physical acquisition/coefficients/frames/restoration/hosting/precision, complete supplier and outer transfer obligations remain open. Lean, Docker, selected full cold replay and hosted CI were not run.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

An isolated research package; existing verifier and scientific inputs are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Package
